html:
Trees use nested [value,left,right] lists; an empty subtree is None. Return whether every node has left and right subtree heights differing by at most one.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      1,
      [
        2,
        null,
        null
      ],
      [
        3,
        null,
        null
      ]
    ]
  ],
  "expected": true
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      1,
      [
        2,
        [
          3,
          null,
          null
        ],
        null
      ],
      null
    ]
  ],
  "expected": false
}
Hint

Return a failure sentinel along with subtree height.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(h) recursion space
